items.title: Al Gafa interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 2, 2023
items.q: And then when I was at the Playboy Club with Kai Winding I wrote another thing called “Dirty Dog” and Kai Winding played it.

ctx.x: How do you — how do you compose? And do you compose on purpose, like I think I’ll write a song today?

No. Okay, there are two ways to compose that I know. One was what you just mentioned. Doc Pomus and Morty Shuman used to spend six and eight hours a day composing. And I didn’t. I would find stuff while I’m practicing or playing and then I’d start to develop it. And I’d develop it into, it would just naturally develop into a tune. So my composing thing comes from practicing and having the guitar in my hands. And the reason I started composing so much is that when I joined the group we were playing a lot of Mike’s…
Did you ever get, or do you ever get checks in the mail for things that you have written?
